commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one original landscape illustration for a personal software project card, 3:2 aspect ratio. The supplied portrait is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create the different subject described below, not a portrait or a person. Match the reference's expressive irregular charcoal-black ink outlines, dry-brush felt-tip shading and relaxed hand-drawn editorial character. Mostly white paper and charcoal, with only a few muted teal strokes and warm mustard-yellow accents, light pale-mint washes if useful. Friendly, thoughtful and clean. A small coherent vignette, not a busy scene. Place the complete recognizable main subject in the upper center, inside the middle 65 percent horizontally and upper 65 percent vertically; retain wide breathing room and keep the bottom 30 percent almost white for separate HTML text. Very light paper texture, clean white background edge to edge. No border, no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, frames around the whole artwork, collage or split panels. No dark environment, neon, glowing lights, photorealism, polished vector art or 3D render. Produce ONE complete illustration. Subject:

images.subject: A passenger airplane flying above a gently folded topographic map with two small weather clouds and a hand-drawn teal flight route. Clear recognizable aircraft silhouette, simple map contour lines, no satellites.

An unbranded compact MIDI piano keyboard viewed at a gentle diagonal, with black and white keys and a cluster of square drum pads picked out in mustard and teal, plus two loose rhythmic brush strokes.

An upright smartphone tilted slightly beside three small usage-meter rings and a few stacked progress bars on its screen. All screen contents are simple hand-drawn shapes without text. Mobile AI usage monitoring.

Three overlapping small photographic prints with generous blank white borders: a mountain, a simple building and a quiet sea. Draw the images too in the reference's ink style, with sparse teal and mustard accents. A tiny blank metadata strip under each print.
A stylus poised over a small pen tablet drawing a single teal curve, with a desktop screen behind it showing the same curve. A loose hand-drawn connector stroke ties the two displays together.

A desktop monitor with a slender row of simple resource gauges along the bottom of its mostly blank screen, and two small floating usage widgets. Black ink monitor outlines, teal and mustard meter accents, no branding.

A half-open laptop whose screen is filled with dry charcoal brush shading; a tiny mustard status light remains on. A small crescent moon and a continuing teal line suggest the display resting while the computer keeps working.

A neat stack of document pages with folded corners beside an open padlock and a tiny simple laptop. Documents have a few abstract diagram strokes, no writing. A friendly metaphor for local PDF processing.

A welcoming miniature university entrance with a reception desk and small check-in tablet. Three simple round visitor tokens follow a curved teal line toward orderly seat markers. No people or labels.
An open weekly planner with an unlabeled grid and a few teal course blocks, a pencil resting across the page, and two small mustard autumn leaves. A friendly academic planning vignette.

A cluster of little activity-grid squares on the left flowing along one loose teal connector into a small standing desk calendar on the right. The calendar is an unlabeled grid, with a few mustard marked cells.

A loose ink double helix made from tiny contribution-grid squares, accompanied by a small hand-drawn branching timeline. Teal and mustard squares among charcoal lines, airy and clearly readable as a coding-activity metaphor.

A small house with solar panels on the roof and a battery beside it. A cheerful mustard sun above and a single teal energy-flow loop connect the panels, battery and home. Simple architectural ink drawing.

A tiny floating block-shaped island with a tree and little workshop, accompanied by a simple friendly chat-bubble companion. Hand-drawn block geometry with irregular black ink, sparse teal foliage and mustard accents, no branded game characters.

An upright phone with a mostly blank screen and evenly spaced teal and mustard motion dots along both screen edges. Two loose curved movement strokes around the device suggest rhythm and gentle movement.
A neatly coiled network cable releasing a flowing stream of tiny teal and mustard dots through a simple speed-gauge arc. Airy hand-drawn marks evoke fast data transfer, no fire or numerals.
A mirrorless camera in a three-quarter view beside two little campus and street photo prints. A few loose teal viewfinder corner marks and mustard light rays suggest a friendly student photo walk.

Three small framed ink drawings arranged as a quiet gallery: a mountain, a coast and architectural shadows. Thin charcoal frames, sparse teal sea and mustard sunshine, a restrained photographic portfolio vignette.

One naturally drawn hand gently guides scattered teal and mustard dots into the shape of a small winter tree and a tiny snowman. Relaxed brush-pen gesture illustration, anatomically plausible five fingers, no text.

Three small material study spheres and a triangular prism catching a mustard light ray. Show different material impressions through loose charcoal hatching and sparse teal washes, with simple drawn shadows. Clearly ink illustration, never realistic rendering.

A small hand-drawn Earth globe with loose continental outlines and two orbit-like teal paths connecting a few blank map tiles. Mustard data dots and tiny ink stars create an airy space-data exploration vignette, no rocket or agency logo.

A playful maker prototype on a tabletop: a tiny motor, microcontroller board, partly open optical-disc tray and a few neatly curving wires. Loose charcoal technical sketch with sparse mustard and teal details, no writing.

A small open study notebook beside stacks of geometric sorting blocks and a branching arrow path. A pencil and two looping teal strokes evoke introductory programming and algorithms. No code, letters or numbers.

A shared field notebook, two camera lenses and a tidy fan of small campus photo prints. A loose teal line links the objects like a welcoming student club, with tiny mustard accents and blank notebook pages.

A small collection of six hand-drawn project tiles, each with a different simple maker symbol, connected by loose branching ink lines. One tile has a camera, one a circuit, one a plane, others simple geometric tools. No text or miniature UI.

A maker's still life of a small circuit board, camera lens, pencil and an open blank notebook, connected by a loose teal brush stroke and a few mustard accent rays. A personal creative-technology identity represented by tools, no human portrait.
